# Cypher Digital

> Cypher Digital provides digital marketing, advertising, design and video services for businesses in Sri Lanka, with a focus on small and medium-sized businesses.

Official website: https://cypherdigital.lk. General enquiries: +94 70 177 2626 (WhatsApp: https://wa.me/94701772626).

The linked service pages are the primary sources for current service scope. Package pages explain available options; confirm current prices, deliverables, advertising budgets and timelines with the agency before booking. Platform availability and advertising policies can change. Educational examples, historical rates and estimates are not client results or guaranteed outcomes. Unfilled placeholders are not confirmed business information.

## Core Services

- [Social media management](https://cypherdigital.lk/social-media-management-sri-lanka): Main social media service page for Sri Lankan businesses; content planning and Facebook/Instagram management.
- [Facebook advertising](https://cypherdigital.lk/facebook-ads-sri-lanka): Paid Facebook campaigns and enquiries for Sri Lankan businesses.
- [Google Ads](https://cypherdigital.lk/google-ads-sri-lanka): Search and other Google advertising campaigns.
- [SEO services](https://cypherdigital.lk/seo-services-sri-lanka): Search engine optimisation for business websites.
- [Web design](https://cypherdigital.lk/web-design-sri-lanka): Business website design and project planning.
- [Graphic design](https://cypherdigital.lk/graphic-design-sri-lanka): Brand, marketing and promotional design services.
- [Video production](https://cypherdigital.lk/video-production-sri-lanka): Promotional, product and business video content.
- [AI video production](https://cypherdigital.lk/ai-video-production-sri-lanka): AI-assisted video and advertising creative production.
- [Lead generation campaigns](https://cypherdigital.lk/lead-generation-campaigns-sri-lanka): Campaign planning and business enquiry generation across marketing channels.
- [Lead follow-up services](https://cypherdigital.lk/lead-follow-up-services-sri-lanka): Follow-up support for enquiries generated by marketing campaigns.
- [AI visibility](https://cypherdigital.lk/ai-visibility-sri-lanka): Services addressing business visibility in AI-assisted discovery.
